name: fetch_image
description: Fetch an image from any public HTTPS host to a local path (private/internal IPs blocked, images only, size-capped)

output.description: Absolute path to the downloaded image file

params.name: url
params.description: HTTPS URL of the image to fetch (any public host; private/internal IPs are blocked)

params.name: out
params.description: Output file path for the downloaded image

params.name: max-bytes
params.description: Maximum allowed file size in bytes (default: 25 MiB)

params.name: licence
params.description: The image's licence, from its search_images result's license (e.g. CC BY-SA 4.0). Recorded in the project's provenance, not used to fetch

params.name: artist
params.description: Who made the image, from its search_images result. Recorded in the project's provenance

params.name: source
params.description: Where search_images found it, from its result's source. Recorded in the project's provenance

params.name: source-url
params.description: The page the image came from, when it is not the url fetched. Recorded in the project's provenance (default: url)

params.name: title
params.description: The image's title, from its search_images result. Recorded in the project's provenance
